description: Reply publicly to a post or a specific comment. Provide account_id and post_id; optionally also comment_id to target a specific comment thread. The reply appears publicly on the post. Max 2200 characters. Consumes 1 interaction credit. Returns the created reply ID.

comment_id.description: Platform comment ID to reply to (optional — replies to a specific comment)

post_id.description: Platform post ID to reply to (or omit to use comment_id only)

name: social_api_reply_to_comment
title: Reply to Comment
